paragraphs: The M8 Gran Coupe uses the S63 — a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 that's part of BMW's performance engine family. It was fitted from 2019 to 2026 across the F93 generation, shared with the M8 Coupe and M8 Convertible. The S63 is the same engine family used in the M5, X5 M and X6 M — a hot-vee turbo layout that's been well-documented over its production run. The M8 Gran Coupe is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
